item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring fine weather to southern China persistently for the rest of this week. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and the weather will be very dry over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. Besides, the broad area of low pressure now over the western North Pacific is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone gradually and edge closer to the vicinity of Luzon in the latter part of this week. Then it will turn northeast and move in the general direction of the Ryukyu Islands.
